chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Safwan from Isa ibn al-Qasim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the pilgrim from Kufa: is it better to begin with Medina or with Mecca? He said: with Medina.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order for a pilgrim from Kufa visiting Medina and Mecca for Haj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the ritual etiquette for Iraqi pilgrims, prioritizing the visit to the Prophet’s tomb in Medina before entering the state of Ihram in Mecca. This preference underscores the Shia emphasis on honoring the Ahl al-Bayt and integrating Ziyarah with the core Hajj rites, reflecting the historical route taken by scholars from Kufa.
